title: Target Client and Project PowerSync directory and browse provider

surfaces.currentBehavior: Implements the Account/Principal-bound PowerSync ClientProjectDirectoryQuerying adapter: it combines local rows with independently reactive Client/Project completeness, exposes only caller-owned pending creates before membership as partial, gates authoritative rows and reconciliation on active membership, merges validated Project archive lifecycle/revision overlays, preserves incomplete Project-to-Client joins, derives content-bound local versions, and cancels both observations with the consumer.
surfaces.notes: The concrete adapter is module-internal and all four streams are lifecycle-owned and drained on close. Real hosted Sync authorization remains required before verification/rehearsal.

securityRequirements: Authoritative rows require active local membership evidence
Only exact same-Principal pending rows remain visible without membership
Cross-Account runtime calls fail before persistence
syncRequirements: Client and Project completion are independent reactive signals
Missing Project-to-Client joins cannot become authoritative empty

migration.rule: Use only target local rows; read no Firebase cache and create no compatibility adapter.
reconciliation: Exact authorized authoritative readback clears only the matching owned overlay
Project allocation optimism remains until aggregate-aware proof

acceptance: Local read, isolation, readiness, restart, cancellation, navigation and aggregate-safe reconciliation cases pass without claiming hosted Sync authorization

surfaces.currentBehavior: Runs 16 synthetic tests for pending/authoritative Client and Project rows, exact selection and membership-gated detail navigation, missing relationships, pre-membership visibility and hidden authority, same-Principal pending isolation, independent reactive completeness, local scope/membership isolation, exact overlay cleanup, allocation preservation, encrypted restart, malformed rows, runtime namespace guards and cancellation.
surfaces.notes: Uses only disposable encrypted local databases and synthetic identities; no hosted endpoint or production data is accessed. Runtime cases now open through the async lifecycle composition with separate attachment/media resources and non-destructive close.

surfaces: Client/Project PowerSync directory provider test suite
